$sources: The species: Knautia arvensis (L.) Coult., field scabious: a perennial to 1 m, the basal leaves in a rosette, lanceolate to pinnatifid, 10-30 cm; flower heads flat, 1.5-4 cm, bluish lilac, on long stalks, flowering July to September (C. Stace, New Flora of the British Isles, 4th ed., Cambridge 2019, Dipsacaceae).
The plants at the Hall of Light's plotted points (the as-built meadow, HallOfLightPlanting.swift and nature.py:922-930), heights 0.4-0.9.
name: Knautia arvensis
note: Lilac heads, as the sheet colours them (0xA08AB0); coming into flower at the end of June. The museum shows it in early summer, Mangzhong to Xiazhi (June).
